subject: Mathematics
title: Statistics
summary: Central tendency ke measures — mean, median aur mode — data ka centre batate hain. Dispersion ke measures — range, mean deviation, variance aur standard deviation — failaav batate hain.
Ungrouped, discrete aur grouped (continuous) data ke formulas, aur shortcut (step-deviation) method yaad rakho.
JEE sawal aksar test karte hain ki har observation shift ya scale karne par mean aur variance kaise badalte hain, aur do groups ka combined mean/variance.

formulas.name: Mean
formulas.formula: x̄ = Σxᵢ/n;  for frequencies x̄ = Σfᵢxᵢ/Σfᵢ;  step deviation x̄ = A + (Σfᵢuᵢ/Σfᵢ)h, uᵢ = (xᵢ − A)/h

formulas.name: Median
formulas.formula: ungrouped: middle value of sorted data;  grouped: l + ((N/2 − C)/f) × h

formulas.name: Mode
formulas.formula: grouped: l + ((f₁ − f₀)/(2f₁ − f₀ − f₂)) × h;  empirical: mode ≈ 3 median − 2 mean
formulas.when: Sabse zyada baar aane wali value.

formulas.name: Mean deviation
formulas.formula: MD about a = Σ|xᵢ − a|/n;  minimum when a = median

formulas.name: Variance and SD
formulas.formula: σ² = Σ(xᵢ − x̄)²/n = Σxᵢ²/n − x̄²;  σ = √σ²

formulas.name: Effect of change of origin and scale
formulas.formula: yᵢ = axᵢ + b ⇒ ȳ = a x̄ + b;  σᵧ² = a²σₓ²;  σᵧ = |a|σₓ
formulas.mistake: Constant jodne se variance nahi badalta — dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Coefficient of variation
formulas.when: Do series ki variability compare karna — kam CV zyada consistent.

formulas.name: Combined variance
formulas.formula: σ² = [n₁(σ₁² + d₁²) + n₂(σ₂² + d₂²)]/(n₁ + n₂),  dᵢ = x̄ᵢ − x̄

formulas.name: Variance of first n natural numbers

topics.title: Choosing a measure
topics.explain: Mean saari values use karta hai par outliers se affect hota hai; median outliers se bacha rehta hai; mode categorical data ke liye. Skewed distributions mein median aksar behtar hai.

topics.title: Range and quartile deviation
topics.explain: Range = maximum − minimum. Quartile deviation = (Q₃ − Q₁)/2. Dono failaav ke simple measures hain.

topics.title: Variance shortcuts
topics.explain: Har deviation nikaalne se bachne ke liye σ² = Σx²/n − x̄² use karo. Grouped data ke liye step-deviation method σ² = h²[Σfu²/N − (Σfu/N)²].

topics.title: Correcting wrong observations
topics.explain: Agar koi value galat likhi gayi, to Σx aur Σx² mein galat value hata kar sahi jodo, phir mean aur variance dobara nikalo.

topics.title: Properties of SD
topics.explain: SD kabhi negative nahi; zero sirf tab jab saari values barabar hon. SD ≥ mean ke about mean deviation.

topics.title: Missing data problems
topics.explain: Mean aur variance diye hon aur ek-do values anjaan, to Σx = n x̄ aur Σx² = n(σ² + x̄²) se equations banao.

ratta: y = ax + b ⇒ σᵧ = |a|σₓ (b doesn't matter).
